name: Social Feed Sync & Link to Post
author: itxiplugins

sections.description:
The Social Feed Sync plugin creates a customizable “link in bio” page for your Instagram profile by allowing you to connect your Instagram posts & reels to individual WordPress posts and pages. It works by reading your feed and providing an intuitive interface to link your grid to your web content. Link your site with your Instagram using your free account at [www.biogr.id] (https://www.biogr.id)

Ideal for creators, brands, and businesses, the Social Feed Sync plugin drives traffic to your website and boosts user engagement. Social Feed Sync is available in both Free and Premium versions. For more details, visit our website here.
TLDR;
– Convert Instagram followers into readers of your website.
– Get set up in minutes with our easy-to-use dashboard.
– Create a branded and customizable “link in bio” page.

Free Version

  • Choose a single wordpress post type
  • Fetch your instagram posts and link up to 3 to wordpress content
  • Social Feed Sync branding

Premium Version

  • Unlimited Instagram post linking.
  • Multiple wordpress post type support
  • Ability to remove Social Feed Sync branding

Easy Integration

Set up Social Feed Sync in moments by connecting your Instagram account via Facebook and generating an API Key.

Customizable Layout

Tailor your “link in bio” page with options to add a site logo, social network links, and configure the layout with Google Tag Manager ID.

Initial Setup

  • Obtain your Instagram Account ID via business.facebook.com.
  • Generate your Access Token by connecting your Instagram through Facebook.
  • Decide between the Free and Premium plans according to your needs.

Support

For further assistance, visit our Support Page or contact us via email at support@biogr.id.

External services

This plugin integrates with Google Tag Manager (GTM) to enable tracking and analytics capabilities on your website.

When enabled, the plugin loads the Google Tag Manager script from https://www.googletagmanager.com and injects it into the page. This script may collect and send data such as page views, user interactions, and other event-based tracking information, depending on the tags configured within GTM.

The data processing and tracking depend on the configurations set in the Google Tag Manager account. Users should review and configure GTM settings to ensure compliance with their privacy policy and applicable data protection regulations.

This service is provided by Google LLC: Terms of Service | Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
1. Download and install the Social Feed Sync plugin (free or premium) from the provided link.
  2. Activate the plugin through the WordPress admin panel.
  3. Follow the steps in the Initial Setup to retrieve and enter your API Key from the Social Feed Sync Dashboard.
sections.faq:
Do I need to be a developer to use Biogrid?

Absolutely not! You don’t need to write any fancy queries or even a single line of code to use this plugin. Once you connect your Instagram account, your posts will be retrieved automatically. You can then visual browse your posts, link them to your WordPress articles and also customize the biogr.id page’s appearance.

How do I upgrade to the premium version?

Visit your dashboard, press on the “Upgrade to Premium” button and follow the wizard to complete the payment. The upgraded site will be moved to the Premium Sites section of your dashboard where you will see a link to download the premium version and a new premium API key.
You will not need to reconnect your Instagram account or authorize biogr.id.
Install and activate the premium version and copy paste the premium API Key to the configuration tab of the plugin.
Please deactivate the free version to avoid any conflict.
